steps.content: The breach created by the submarine's collision lasts mere seconds before the tentacles reconstitute into a new barrier, engulfing Pylgia as she charges in alone.
For what seems like an eternity, you hear nothing but silence through the radio—except for the sickening squelch of myriad putrid, slimy tentacles coiling around the hatch.
But this will not the end for the two of you—not here, not now.

The monster's piercing shriek cuts through water and steel, but this hellish sound now rings like sweet music, heralding victory. The entwined tentacles convulse and withdraw, their barrier crumbling away.

You finally behold the monster's true form—a fusion of fish fins and scales intertwined with the razor-sharp claws of crustaceans. Pervaded by bloodless, decaying flesh, this creature appears to be a grotesque patchwork of every terror the deep sea has to offer.
A colossal breach now gapes through the center of the monster's body. You can even see charred fragments of flesh drifting around its periphery.
And through that hole, you find that familiar spare figure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia!
The tiny harpoon thrusts deep into the monster's head. Then, as the tip expands, she rips off an entire section of shell and tissue.
Despite the monster being gravely injured, the figure exhibits no sign of slowing, darting around it at a dizzying speed akin to a razor-sharp blade, leaving a tempest of shredded flesh in her wake.
The monster is unable to match her speed in the slightest, its tentacles thrashing frenziedly yet unable to land even a single hit.
You start the engine, your target crystal clear this time—the monster's head. The submarine is just a few dozen meters from the monster, which is close enough for you.

Once again, the steel vessel transforms into a weapon, hurtling directly at the cornered mass of flesh. The weighty hull drives into the monster's body as the high-speed propellers rend through its tender innards.
[Fade Out to Switch Scene]
Seconds later, the submarine drills out from the other side of the monster. Just as you expected, its massive body shatters and slowly sinks back to where it came from—the dark Abyss.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We did it!
In a distance, Pylgia swiftly swims towards the submarine. The insidious monster has at last been silenced. This triumph is one shared between the two of you.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: No more monsters... Let me guide you back.
The path back is now unobstructed, and together you will return to the expedition with both your injured companions and the crucial data collectors.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Hehe...

Behind you, a hollow laugh emanates from your "companion." He was controlled by something from the Abyss, but with the monster vanquished, a glimmer of hope catches you that he may revert to his former self.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ragnar, you're awake. We can go back now. The monster has been killed...

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Hehehe... killed... the monster?

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Isn't it... still right there...?
Ragnar directs your attention to the porthole. Following his gesture, you only see Pylgia swimming towards you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not the monster. It's Pylgia.
You offer the radio to him, let him speak to Pylgia directly. However, he only spares a glance at it before pivoting back to you with an unsettling grin.
Only now do you realize that the radio is entirely muted, with nothing but silence emanating from the speaker.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It must've been damaged during the collision... Pylgia was just talking to me...
Pylgia has returned to the submarine's side, and through the glass you see that familiar figure. You turn back to Ragnar, gesturing toward her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look, she's back. Don't...
You freeze in place, your words faltering in your throat.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pyl...gia...?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'm here. Everything's fine now.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...Is there... anything wrong?
[Big CG 2 Section 2]
A calm voice responds to you. You stiffly turn your head. As she's always done, Pylgia remains hovering there, gazing at you in silence.

Beneath her tattered diving suit, her bared skin is eerily pale, almost translucent, as if enveloped in an otherworldly white glow. The suit clearly no longer shields her from the crushing pressure and frigid cold that would be fatal to any mortal, yet she remains there, her usual calm demeanor making her seem impervious.
There's no mistake—this is Pylgia, the Pylgia you know so well, and also the white figure you first encountered when you entered this "dream."

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Too late... It's too late... I told you... the monster never died... they're everywhere... everyone is a monster!
An excruciating pain seizes your chest, causing your legs to give way. Only by leaning against the porthole do you manage to remain upright.
In this position, you finally see Pylgia's true form in its entirety.
(CG3)
Beneath her human torso, several chitinous tentacles—much like those of the monster you killed—stretch down, disappearing into the darkness where your eyes cannot follow.
In your despair, you raise your gaze, only to see Pylgia's sorrowful eyes that hold unspoken words.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: A monster... huh...
Pylgia can no longer be considered human by any measure. She has long since transformed into a monster. That dream was a forewarning—everything you have done has been futile.
From the very beginning, you were destined to fail in saving her...
At the moment reality becomes clear, something within your mind abruptly fractures.
The pressure gauge's needle spins wildly. The world lurches in tandem. Infinite darkness floods into the battered, leaking submarine, devouring you in a heartbeat.
That sorrowful figure reaches out to you at the last moment, yet you are already engulfed by overwhelming regret, sliding inevitably into the deepest, farthest dark.
Your last shreds of sanity form into a few fragmented words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Abyss... fear... dive...
Soon, even this vestige of cognition is devoured. Your final recollection of reality is Ragnar's frenzied wails.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Sinking... sinking again... I knew there's no escape... We're all going to die here...
